services_shape: one-to-one sessions of 50 minutes, with a practitioner the client picks or any free one; video sessions; packs of sessions; a home or office visit
questions_before_times: what the client wants to work on, in their own words (a habit, sleep, stress, confidence)
in the studio, by video, or at a home or office
a practitioner by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
for a teen (16 or 17): the age; a parent or guardian books
safety_stop: thoughts of harming yourself or someone else, or a crisis right now
a seizure, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing, or hearing voices that tell someone to act
epilepsy, a recent head injury, or a psychosis diagnosis
license: none checked by Rosie: hypnotherapy has no state license in most places; a certificate or membership is the practitioner's own word, optional, and never checked (D96)
staff_skills: hypnotherapy for habits, sleep, stress and confidence; relaxation and take-home audio; only practitioners with the training a booking names are offered
messages_never: the reason for a visit, goals, health answers, medicines, a doctor's note and the practitioner's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
